setting: assets/map06_port/LAYOUT.json: enemy_attack_resource_trial=1; set to 0, regenerate MAP06 and rebuild to restore resource limits and physical fallback.

Both admit magical attacks, spend Anima and spawn real projectiles at zero.
Insufficient partial resources clamp to zero; no negative balance or refill.
Defender, unregistered enemy and friendly-converted enemy retain normal resource limits.
